label: Improved method: 2011 data with the corrections and the improved method
description: The 2011 data and zones of 2011-corrected with the corrections (biodiesel-yield (biodiesel yield from oilseeds: oil content counted once); beef-carcase-yield (beef carcase-to-retail yield restored (0.705))) and the improved method (line 2): reserve-pro-rata (reserve and infrastructure shortfall shared across cropping, pasture and non-agricultural land); recycling-stage (recycling split by stage, origin, dry matter, the law in force and uptake by stage). Compare with 2011-fixed for the effect of the improvements on the old data, and with 2025-improved for the effect of the data. The recycling module's practice of 2018-19 is the only data it has, so the 2011 short term borrows it.
errata: Resilience: the improved method for the 2025 cell may later include a leave-one-out resilience table; that table is data of its own vintage and has not been computed for the 2011 cell, so it is not in the improved list.
